commands.label: Record the headless Node.js host for the original OxRun worker
Compile and run the unchanged hello.ox in the published OxRun WebAssembly engine

isolation: The published worker loaded the recorded WebAssembly and standard-library files from disk and received the source in a network namespace without external connectivity.

updated_expectation.expected_result: The OxRun worker emits Hello, World! on its stdout stream and reports Ox exit code 0.

toolchain: Ox 10.033 (Browser_32), published OxRun WebAssembly worker libox-BESqAKjh.js in Node.js v22.20.0
reproduction_command: node oxrun_worker_runner.cjs oxrun_assets.json hello.ox with the files and digests recorded in the evidence
semantic_scope: The published Ox compiler and runtime loaded their packaged standard library, compiled the original hello.ox and ran its main function. The worker emitted the exact greeting and reported exit code 0 in a headless WSL process.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
